Then the correlation features were calibrated, their dimensionality was reduced by Locality Preserving Projection (LPP) method and a one-class Support Vector Data Description (SVDD) classifier was trained to make classification. The new method trained only on examples of cover images. The results show that it's able to afford reasonable accuracy to distinguish between cover and stego images. Furthermore, LPP method is much better than Principal Components Analysis (PCA) method for improving the algorithm's classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Commutation torque ripple reduction in brushless DC motor based on equivalent voltage coefficient control
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel method to inhibit the commutation torque ripple in a brushless dc motor based on the analysis of equivalent voltage coefficient. The equivalent voltage coefficient is analyzed at low speed with PWM in incoming phase and at high speed with PWM in outgoing phase separately. By setting the equivalent voltage coefficient in commutation period to the conduction period, commutation torque ripple is significantly reduced. Simulation and experimental results show the validity of this control technique.

articleTitle: Signal circuit and cold junction compensation of fiber-optic thermocouple sensor
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A fiber-optic thermocouple sensor is proposed in this paper, which is composed of a number of optical fiber and thermocouple sensor. A signal processing circuit of the fiber-optic thermocouple sensor is designed and a cold junction compensation method is also introduced. This paper focuses on analyzing optical fiber sensor signals and the cold junction compensation method in the case of multi-channel temperature measurements. The cold junction compensation method is based on the Newton iterative algorithm, which is embedded in a microprocessor. An experiment of temperature measurement is fulfilled and hence testifies the feasibility of the proposed fiber-optic thermocouple sensor and its cold junction compensation method.

articleTitle: Route information piggybacking in multihop wireless networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Loop-free routing is one of the most desirable qualities for multihop wireless networks. In this paper, we propose a new loop-free mechanism, Route Information Piggybacking (RIP), which emphasizes the utilization of data packets to facilitate route maintenance and loop detection. RIP is a lightweight mechanism and it can be easily integrated into any on-demand distance-vector routing protocol. We have applied RIP to a native but flawed on-demand distance-vector routing algorithm in mobile ad hoc networks, and we call the new routing protocol Simple Mobile Ad hoc RouTing (SMART). Extensive simulation results reveal that SMART achieves loop-freedom effectively, and it outperforms AODV significantly in terms of scalability, routing overhead and delivery ratio.

articleTitle: An algorithm for removing redundancy features in microarray data
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, information acquisition ability is constantly improved. It constantly produces all kinds of high-dimensional data, triggering the “dimension disaster”. It is urgent to reduce the dimension of these high-dimensional data and discover the feature that is truly meaningful. Here, a new multi-stage dimensionality reduction algorithm based on removing redundancy features is proposed. The irrelevant features are removed firstly, and then the redundant features are removed. The experiment result shows that the algorithm is feasible and effective in microarray data.

articleTitle: Translating software requirement from natural language to automaton
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The problems in the requirement using natural language, such as incomplete, inconsistent, ambiguous, can lead to delays or even failures in software projects. The requirement using formal specification can solve these problems. However, translating software requirements from natural language to formal specification has always been a difficulty. This paper proposes a new method for the translation from the natural language to a formal specification, the automaton. Firstly, a constrained structure of natural language is used to specify the requirements, and then two tables are used to extract the characteristics of requirements. At last, the translation from natural language to automaton will finish with help of control structure chart of requirement.

articleTitle: The design of electric power wireless broadband network traffic carrying capacity test system
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper proposes a plan of the distribution network communication test system based on MCWILL system, and realizes the design of business communication simulation module and carries capacity test module. A power communication business test system is successfully designed.The system introduces the concept of business success rate, which is used to evaluate the overall performance of the network, and analyses the data goodput, delay, packet loss rate, and retransmission rate of power business in the broadband wireless communication network. What's more , the system introduces adjustable background current to change the test pressure of the network, by comparing the performance metrics from different pressure environment. The system can judge whether the wireless communication system can meet the requirements of power business data communications.

articleTitle: Combat effectiveness evaluation method of photoelectric defense system based on BP neural network optimized by bat algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The combat effectiveness is an important indicator of the photoelectric defense system quality. When used in combat, the influence factors of the combat effectiveness are complex and show a nonlinear relationship. This paper proposes to apply the BP neural network to combat effectiveness evaluation, propose the thought of make the photoelectric defense system combat effectiveness value to different “classification”. For the problem of the structure of BP neural network is difficult to determine, this paper puts forward to optimize the BP neural network weights and threshold by the bat algorithm, which gets the best weights and threshold of BP neural network. The example verifies the validity of the methods above, which overcome the weakness of the expert decision-making system not easy to modify and the poor quality of the adaptive ability.

articleTitle: The methods of electric power dedicated broadband wireless network traffic load capacity test system
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: An electric power dedicated broadband wireless network traffic load capacity test and evaluation method is designed, which will be used for the performance test and evaluation of grid wireless communication network. This method can be used in the actual broadband wireless communication network, to count and analyze the data goodhput, delay, packet loss rate, and retransmission rate performance of power business in the broadband wireless communication network. The capacity performance of broadband wireless communication system can be evaluated, then it can judge whether the wireless communication system can meet the requirements of power business data communications.

articleTitle: Compressive sensing based adaptive synchronous estimation for Frequency Hopping signal
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: With good sparsity of Frequency Hopping (FH) signals on the local Fourier basis based on compressive sensing (CS) theory, this paper proposes a novel adaptive synchronous estimation method of hopping frequency for FH signal. Given the hop interval, and by continuously adjusting the starting time of observation, the hopping frequencies can be estimated with a few measurements and without reconstructing the original signal. Simulation results show that the method can achieve relatively ideal synchronous performance and frequency estimation performance at lower compression ratio and lower signal to noise ratio (SNR).

articleTitle: An OpenFlow-based network architecture of substation equipment on-line monitoring system and performance analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The network architecture of substation equipment on-line monitoring is difficult to meet the performance requirements, based on the analysis of the substation equipment on-line monitoring system. Then the OpenFlow protocol standard is proposed to include into the existing monitoring system. The new network architecture based on OpenFlow is described in detail, and test the performance of OpenFlow switches used Agilent N2X. The simulation results show that the OpenFlow switches have better performance than the Industrial Ethernet switches of the measures. It greatly improves the efficiency of the network communication.

articleTitle: Coupled drive leg of quadrupedal robot mechanism design and analysis of energy consumption
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The system mechanical properties play an important role in dynamic quadrupedal robot control reseach. This paper describes a new coupled drive leg for quadrupedal robot. Numerical studies have been done to investigate the mechanical power and energy of the coupled drive leg and direct drive leg in the same control algorithms .When the robot is walking at speed of 0.13m / s, the robot of the coupling legs than the direct drive in the unit time saving energy ratio η = 15. 24%, while at a speed of 0.19m / s, η = 22. 59%.The results show that the coupled leg design has higher efficiency.

articleTitle: Shape control of membrane reflector with electrostatic forming
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A high accuracy membrane reflector shape control approach is presented in this paper. Based on the electrostatic forming theory, the shape of the membrane reflector can be corrected by adjusting the voltages on electrodes which are attached to the mesh reflector as a foundation. An analytical model of the system is deduced based on the virtual work principle, including the membrane reflector, electrodes and controller. Distortions caused by external disturbances are dealt with this method and the feasibility of this control system is demonstrated by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Topological structure design of cleaning manipulator for aircraft surfaces based on single-open-chain
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Based on topological structure design theory and method of Position and Orientation Characteristics, the thesis analyzed the topological characteristics of serial robot with six degrees of freedom and synthesized the single-open-chain mechanisms containing five revolute joints and one prismatic joints. And then two mechanism which summarizes two topological structures meeting 5R1P optimized index has been designed. Theoretical innovative approaches of single-open-chain mechanism for application in aircraft cleaning are put forward.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis on flow characteristics of cryogenic fluid in 90-degree bend duct
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: When analyzing flow characteristics of cryogenic fluid flows through bend duct based on CFD and Fluent, establishing and selecting suitable numerical calculation method is significance to the accuracy of the calculation result. This paper proposes a FR k-ε turbulent model which adding filter function on the basis of the Realizable k-ε model, adopts the full cavitation model, and calculates the pressure, velocity and cavitation based on Fluent when liquid oxygen flows through the square-sectioned 90-degree bend duct. It compared the calculation result with that calculated by Realizable k-ε and RNG k-ε turbulent model. From the experimental results we can know that the proposed FR k-ε model can more accurately reflect the flow characteristics of liquid oxygen flows through square-sectioned 90-degree bend duct, and better capture the change of flow field, and the calculation results are more close to the experimental data.

articleTitle: Controller parameters optimization of large inertia and time-varying load system based on extremum seeking algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: It is difficult to tune controller parameters for large inertia and time-varying load system. To solve this problem, a new controller parameters optimization strategy based on extremum seeking algorithm is proposed. This novel method is model-free. It utilizes data of experiments to get the gradient information of performance to control parameters, so as to tune the controller parameters. This paper analyzes the convergence of extremum seeking algorithm and proposes the high-pass filter parameters selection principles. Simulation and experimental results show that the system control performance is significantly improved using extremum seeking algorithm compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: The garlic classification based on linear regression model
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A machine vision method may be used for estimation of garlic size during postharvest processing with the aim of classification of garlic. Such machine vision system enables the garlic growers to efficiently manage and can help increase profits. In this paper a model of linear regression analysis was established and used for the garlic classification, according to the relationship between garlic diameter and other garlic image features.

articleTitle: Study of the industrial control network reliability comprehensive model
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Industrial control network was a complex system which consisted of operating system, control software, failure diagnosis software, hardware and connecting device. In this paper, we studied how the typical industrial control network works and proposed a reliability comprehensive model. Based on the network device layer reliability model and topology layer reliability model, this model considered task demands, task profiles as well as human factors. This model was able to simulate the failure behavior and failure characteristics more realistically than ever. In the end, through a typical case we analyzed its specific application.

articleTitle: Motion deblurring based on edge prior
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Restoring clear image from degraded images has long been one challenging problem in digital imaging. In this paper, we present a deblurring method with edge prior and wavelet analysis. A preprocessing step is proposed to remove noise before deblurring, then uses shock filter to enhance edges and canny operation to detect edges for estimating kernel. After that, maximize the sparsity of clear image under tight wavelet frame system. Furthermore, the split Bregman method is proposed to solve the optimization problem. Finally, we will get the clear image. The experiments show that our algorithm can remove motion blurring effectively.

articleTitle: Design of embedded multi-language lattice font based on QT
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper analyzes the shortage of QT font interface compared with embedded system. For the open source QT version, the paper designs a self-defining and multi-language lattice font which not only has fast performance of QPF lattice font and multi-language support of TTF vector font, but also has multiple features and supports extracting multinational language font with different styles which are to be stored in the same font. The font realizes seamless integration with QT, and the font is applicable to multi-language application and development of embedded interactive interface based on QT.

articleTitle: Pressure simulation analysis on centrifugal separation field of horizontal spiral centrifuge
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: According to actual size of geometric screw centrifuge and CFD visualization methods, a geometry model is established, which has structured gridding produced to improve the accuracy of grid computation. The law of pressure change of the centrifugal separation field is studied. The results showed that the centrifugal motor dynamic pressure and static pressure considerably agree with the law of pressure change of the rotating vortex field. The dynamic and static pressure increases along the radial direction of the liquid ring, and reaches the maximum at the drum internal wall. The dynamic pressure and static pressure tend to increase with the drum speed rising and the maximum is at the drum wall. This means the highest strength appears in the drum central position. Therefore the intensity of the central drum should be strengthened during the design of the centrifuge drum. The static pressure changes dramatically in the spill plate, which affects the sludge content to some extent after dehydration, so the size of the pressure difference should be controlled.

articleTitle: Geogram based feature description
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: We introduce the concept of a geogram which is a generalization of spatiogram that includes more rich features. The spatiograms contain some moments upon the coordinates of the pixels corresponding to each histogram bin while the geograms contain information about the perimeter of grouped regions in addition to features in spatiogram. The perimeter of certain region has capability to represent the geometrical compactness of a feature distribution. The geogram based feature descriptor increases accuracy of tracking because of the descriptor using features in lower levels. Also, we consider that a convergence process of mean shift based on spatiogram is divided into obvious dynamic and steady states as well as in the control system, and introduce a technique in automatic control region, or a hybrid technique of geogram and traditional histogram, into controlling of convergence process. Moreover, we derive a formula for mean shift based on the proposed geogram and analyze the convergence behavior of this algorithm.

articleTitle: The research of direct digital frequency synthesis based on FPGA
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper introduced the principle of DDS technology using of Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA). It mainly describes the circuit structure and optimization method and designs the VHDL source code adopting on the chip EP1C3T144C8 Cyclone I family FPGA using ALERA Company. It has been greatly applied in electronic design.

articleTitle: The analysis of MAC layer protocol in UWASN
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: As the emerging cross research field of the acoustic, marine and information science, underwater acoustic sensor networks(UWASN) has not mature and general media access control protocol(MAC) yet. Three types popular wireless communication protocol, TDMA, 802.11 and S-MAC were researched and analyzed according that some respect performance of them is suitable for underwater acoustic channel. The modification for UWASN was put forward by analyzing and comparing the characteristics of three protocols, such as bandwidth utilization, time-lapse and energy consumption. Finally the simulation methods of MAC layer protocol for underwater acoustic channel were presented.

articleTitle: An implementation of the QR iterations for finding eigenvalues of matrices with CUDA on GPU
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Based on the principle of QR loop iterations, this paper implements a parallel algorithm based on the hardware of GPU (Graphic Process Unit) by using routines from CUDA (Computer Unified Device Architecture) to find the eigenvalues of general matrices. CPU and GPU computing card form a client-server computing framework. Here, CPU can be regarded as a client and GPU card is considered as a computing server. For the experiment environment, this paper chooses a GPU card with the model of NVIDIA GeForce GTX460 as a server side and a CPU with the model of Intel Core i5-760 quad-core as a client side. Win7 64-bit is selected as the operating system. The parallel implementation consists of two parts:PA H and PA QR. PA H is a procedure that transforms a matrix A into the Hessenberg matrix B. PA QR is the actual parallel algorithm of the QR iterations that is imposed on the Hessenberg matrix B for finding eigenvalues of the general matrix A. The speedup ratio of the proposed algorithm is jarless when the number of iterations becomes greater. The experimental results show that the parallel implementation with CUDA on GPU only makes use of less running time than traditional sequential algorithms. The speedup ratio of PA H is between 1.79 and 7.81. The speedup ratio of PA QR is between 3.24 and 118.9. Especially, when the order of general matrix equals 8192, the amount of iterations becomes 10000. The speedup ratio of the PA-H and the PA QR can run up to 7.81 and 118.9 respectively.

articleTitle: Just-in-time decision of demand respond based on complex event processing technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: As an important part of the smart grid, demand respond needs to be developed to meet the requirements of electricity consumption event online monitoring, real-time analysis and automatic response. Firstly, the typical demand response business models are designed and the online analysis context environments are ensuing determined. Then, a three layers framework of demand response just-in-time decision based on complex event processing technology is designed on the basis of the basic input/output event models and general operating rules. Finally, the rule of demand respond just-in-time decision technical in the auxiliary grid load shifting and regional load balancing is verified through intelligent electric equipment real-time operation control experiment. The experimental results show that the proposed technology is helpful to modify the load curve and reduce the peak-valley ratio.

articleTitle: Audit method primitive design and implementation
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper presented an audit method primitive framework in the field of social security computer audit for the first time. This framework described the process of social security audit, such as data collection process, the pre-processing and analysis process. The experimental results show that the primitive framework supplies a more efficient way to generate audit method in actual work. This primitive framework is easy to use due to its simple structure. Thus it can be used as an intermediate language to formulate audit process in the social security audit answering system.

articleTitle: The study on fuzzy face recognition of low-quality images
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, an in-depth study is made on the fuzzy face recognition technology based on the shape features. In view of the defects and deficiency of the traditional Active Shape Model (ASM) method in the process of feature extraction, several improved methods are put forward. In the improved algorithm, the initial position is initialized by using the method of pupil localization; in the extraction of the gray scale information of the feature points, a method is designed by forming a circular area centered on the feature points and extracting meaningful pixel information from this area. All of these methods have effectively improved the performance of the ASM method. An experimental analysis is made on the algorithm, and the experimental results show that the modified ASM method has been improved both in the accuracy and in the robustness of fuzzy face recognition.

articleTitle: The combination method based on weighted distance of evidence
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: As to solve the problems of highly conflict in evidence synthesis, we propose a new combination method based on Murphy's method and Deng's weighted averaging method. The new method uses Murphy method to determine the weight of evidence, and calculate the distance of evidences under the modified City Block distance norm. Then we can get the support degree of evidences and use Dempster's method to realize the information fusion after normalizing the support degree of each evidence. Experimental results show that this method not only can fuse the highly conflict evidence effectively, but also identify the target more quickly.

articleTitle: Smooth reverse motion control of 6-DOF hydraulic parallel robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Hydraulic parallel robot is widely applied to motion simulators, whereas the smooth reverse motion of hydraulic parallel robot is quite significant to ensure the verisimilitude of simulators. The maximum static friction and dynamic friction were analyzed by using the LuGre dynamic friction model and Stribeck negative slope effect. The increased pressure caused by motion inertia and the pressure jump caused by asymmetric structure were derived, which both happen in the reverse motion of hydraulic parallel robot. Strategies including control method and structure design to smooth the reverse motion were proposed, and the validity was proved through experiment.

articleTitle: Research on the user behavior analysis based on improved Apriori
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: With the global economic development and the business data explosively increasing, analysis of user behaviors is paid more and more attention to. So what kind of data mining technology adopted to realize the user behavior analysis has become a research hotspot. Apriori algorithm is to mine association rules in the vast amounts of data and find the relationship between the data items. But its I/O is expensive and low efficiency, forming the performance bottleneck of the algorithm. This paper has adopted improved Apriori based on matrix to analyze the data. By comparing with the traditional Apriori algorithm, the improved algorithm has achieved obvious improvement both in running speed and excavating performance. In addition, it has set up a user behavior analysis system based on the algorithm, and briefly introduced its design.

articleTitle: Research of atmospheric profiles inversion by mountain-based GPS occultation
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Mountain-based GPS occultation technique is a new method to explore the profiles of global meteorological fields of neutral atmosphere, from which we can obtain the atmosphere refractivity, air pressure, density, temperature, and water vapor. So far some research departments have done several occultation experiments on mountains such as mount Wuling in Hebei, mount Wutai in Shanxi and mount Fuji in Japan. From these experiments they successfully obtained the atmospheric refractivity profiles around the mountains. As is known, the altitude of the mountain has a great effect on the mountain-based GPS occultation experiment. And all these mountains referred before have the altitude of more than 2000 meters, so these bring great advantages to their experiments. Since there may not be any high mountains in most regions, applications of mountain with moderate altitude based GPS occultation technique will cover more area of time and space. In this short paper, the mountain-based GPS occultation experiment on the mountain with 870 meters altitude is introduced. In our ten days' experiment, 110 occultation events have been observed, and 41 atmospheric profiles are successfully obtained with the GPS occultation, which suggest that mountain-based GPS occultation experiment could be operated on a relatively low mountain, thus this occultation method could be used in many regions. And by analyzing these successful observational data and unsuccessful observational data, some requirements and matters needing attention in mountain-based GPS occultation are given. These will provide valuable references for the after occultation observations. Finally, in the end of this paper, the prospect of mountain-based GPS occultation is discussed.

articleTitle: An open 5-DOF manipulator platform and its control applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to study the hardware, software, and control algorithms for robot manipulators, an open 5-DOF robot manipulator experimental platform is built. This platform has the open feature by which the researchers can access software as well as hardware of the system. The study results on manipulator remote control and force control by using this experimental platform show this experimental platform has open characteristics: the DSP hardware controller, MATLAB software, control algorithms, etc. can be employed. Therefore, it provides an excellent experimental platform for robotics research.

articleTitle: A fast and stable anti-collision algorithm for the EPCglobal UHF Class 1 Generation 2 standard
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The EPC C1 Gen2 (Electronic Product Code Class 1 Generation 2) standard uses the traditional Q-algorithm to solve the tag anti-collision problem. The interrogator needs to frequently send QueryAdjust command to adjust the frame length when multiple tags or no tags synchronously response to the interrogator in a time slot, so that the system will consume a lot of energy, and the system throughput is also very low. According to these deficiencies, this paper proposes a fast and stable algorithm, named FSQ algorithm, by dynamically adjusting Q value to lower the frequency of interrogator sending QueryAdjust command, and through optimizing the time slots, the simulation results indicate FSQ algorithm outperforms the traditional Q-algorithm and the system power consumption has been got greatly lowered.

articleTitle: A reduce points algorithm of radial basis function dynamic mesh method
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A reduce points algorithm was presented and applied to radial basis function dynamic mesh method. According to the given error, the algorithm had chosen some points form all the points on the CFD surface mesh. By interpolating an approximately surface on the selected points, the algorithm fill the drawback of radial basis function dynamic mesh method by reducing the computation time and storage. Taking m6 wing as an example, the simulation results show the initial point's insensitivity and the high efficiency of this algorithm. The algorithm can reduce the computation time of the dynamic mesh several times or even more. This property would be helpful in reducing the nonlinear aeroelasticity computation time and storage.

articleTitle: New separation method of noisy mixed images based on DSD process
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In allusion to the applicability of independent component analysis to noise-free signal separation and its limitation of poor effect when used for noisy signal, this paper gives a denoising strategy named DSD process which uses independent component analysis for the separation of noisy mixed images. In this scheme, wavelet transform is first used to denoise noisy images; then, independent component analysis is used for the separation of denoised images; finally, wavelet transform is used again to denoise separated images again; thus, clear images are obtained. The simulation experiment shows that this method can effectively improve the peak signal to noise ratio and correlation coefficient of the separation result of noisy mixed images and has a good effect.

articleTitle: The prediction issue of image tracker delay and two related improvements
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To reduce the impact of the tracker delay in the image tracking system, an equivalent model of the correction method with prepensely delayed turntable angle is reached by mathematic deduction, which shows this method can theoretically eliminate the distortion impact to the tracking response; The remaining impact is just a pure delay to the target angle, which can be described as a special signal prediction issue. And then an improved polynomial fitting and prediction algorithm is proposed. It raises the prediction frequency from the image frame frequency to the turntable angle sensor's frequency without too much addition to the real-time calculation. Depending on the statistical regularity of polynomial fitting, a further method is proposed using the last residua prediction error. The simulation results show that, the two improvements can be more approximate to the true values and reduce the impact of the tracker delay effectually, and can be applied with other prediction algorithm easily.

articleTitle: The study on digital watermarking based on word document
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Digital watermarking as a new technology of copyright protection can effectively protect copyright of digital products. Today, the research of digital watermarking mainly focuses on image, video and audio. This paper designs and implements a text digital watermarking algorithm based on the word document through study several technologies of text digital watermarking. It realizes the watermark embedding by modifying the font of the letters in word document. Finally, it analyzes and proves the feasibility of the algorithm through a series of test.

articleTitle: Timeout strategy of sampled flow in high-speed networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Timeout is one of the most important features of flow recognition, which determines the maximum time interval between adjacent packets. Sampling technology has now been widely used in measurement systems to control the problem of processing overhead and memory consumption. When packet sampling is used, the timeout of original flow is not suitable for the sampled flow. The inappropriate timeout can lead to flow joining or flow splitting, and it may reduce the accuracy of measurement systems. In this paper, we propose a timeout strategy of sampled flow, which can produce an optimal timeout of sampled flow according to the original flow timeout and packet sampling rate. A reasonable timeout of sampled flow can reduce the probabilities of flow joining or flow splitting. The theoretical analysis shows that the number of flow joining and flow splitting can achieve a tradeoff when we adopt the timeout of sampled flow. And the experimental result also demonstrates that original flow length distribution can be obtained accurately by using the timeout of sampled flow.

articleTitle: The Horizontal angle measurement of TBM guidance system
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In real-time measurement process of shield machine's Guiding system, Horizontal angle measurement has always been a problem for attitude. In order to achieve the level of real-time measurement of the angle, I designed a self-contained laser target based on convex lens' focusing characteristics. Using laser and industrial camera I realized the measurement of angular by image processing method. Experimental data show that the measuring angle can range ±5 degrees, accuracy can reach 1 mrad. The results can satisfy the demands of underground tunnel construction.

articleTitle: Improved moving objects detection method based on codebook model
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Traditional Gaussian mixture model cannot cope with illumination changes in the scene and slowly-moving objects. Codebook model cannot detect foreground objects in the training process. The algorithm is proposed in the paper. It uses the background of Gaussian mixture model to build codebook model. Using Frame difference to determine changes in the environment and update the codebook model. This approach solves the problem of mutant changes in the environment. Experiments show that the approach can detect foreground object in complex environment, eliminate shadows effectively and detect the foreground object more accurately.

articleTitle: MLFMA optimal decomposing strategy
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To decompose the far-neighborhood and near-neighborhood data domains of Multi-Level Fast Multi-Pole Algorithm (MLFMA), an optimal parallel implementation is discussed in this paper. To solve this problem, the characteristics of the two fields are respectively considered. Especially in the near-neighborhood decomposing, the clustering property of data is applied. The effectiveness of the optimized strategy is demonstrated by experimental results. Comparing with the former strategy, a higher parallel efficiency is obtained.

articleTitle: Allocation and optimization for performance indexes of the flight control system based on equivalent system matching
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Performance parameters are the basis of a system design. The optimum performance of the subsystems not always assembles to obtain the optimum performance of the main system. So it's necessary to allocate and optimize the index parameters. This paper firstly introduced definition of the index-allocator which was used to allocate the index parameters of the systems. And the nonlinear programming method was firstly used to allocate and optimize damping ratio and control bandwidth of the flight control system based on the low order equivalent system. In the meantime, the impact of the allocation results on the control accuracy was considered. Simulations verify that the allocation approach is reasonable and feasible.

articleTitle: An improved kernel discriminate analysis on grassmannian manifold for face recognition
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Accompany with the understanding for geometry structure of manifold, more and more people used the Grassmannian manifold to face recognition via image sets. In order to improve the accuracy of recognition, several studies applied the discriminant analysis on such manifolds. However, most of these methods suffer from not considering the local structure of the manifold data. Accounting for success of the Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) matrices in many algorithms, an improved method of discriminant analysis on Grassmannian manifold has been proposed in this paper. Similar to the conventional method, our approach map the SPD matrices to a high dimensional Hilbert space where Euclidean geometry applies also. With the Grassmannian kernel function which derived from Gaussian kernel use the different metric for Riemannian manifold of SPD matrices, the local geometry of mapping can be considered. The graph embedding on new feature space can get a better performance than conventional methods. Experiments on CMU PIE and BANCA databases demonstrate the efficient of our method.

articleTitle: An efficient method for rectangle preform simulation of four-step 3D braided composites
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: According to the simulation analysis and discipline of the yarn's movement, an efficient method - reflection method is proposed for fitting geometric structure of three-dimensional braided preforms. Using C++ and Solidworks API, the software which can automatically generate the integral geometric structure of three-dimensional braided performs is programmed. Compared with the traditional method, the novel method significantly simplifies the simulation process without affecting the precision of geometric structure. As a result, the process design time of the preform is shortened. It establishes the foundation of microstructure and mechanical properties analysis for the preforms with complex geometric structures.

articleTitle: A new method in acquisition to detect GNSS spoofing signal
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Spoofing is a huge threat to navigation system. Anti-spoofing in acquisition can firstly find spoofing signal. In this paper, a new method is proposed to alarm receiver whether there is a spoofing signal: in acquisition stage, if receiver finds two correlation peaks above a threshold for two times continuously, it indicates a spoofing signal; while if one peak, only if the rough signal-to-noise ratio is lower than a power threshold and the width of correlation function is lower than a width threshold, it has no spoofing signal. The theoretical calculation methods of thresholds above are all presented there. Also, the influence factors and performance analysis is presented. Results show that we give a quantitative power threshold; and by introducing the width of correlation function, it can deal with the condition that the authentic and spoofing signals are overlap, while methods existed can't. Our work is significant for designing anti-spoofing receiver.

articleTitle: Algorithm research of the starting point detecting function used in welding robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The starting point detecting function is used in the welding robot. Currently, it is only used when the workpiece has translated. However, in practice, the workpiece is not only translation, but also rotation. Therefore, algorithm research of the starting point detecting function has important significance to the practical application of the welding robot. The principle of the starting point detecting function is analyzed. The algorithm of the starting point detecting function which only used to detect two surfaces is studied systematically. The mathematical expressions are proposed based on the coordinate translation and the coordinate rotation. The errors between the taught and actual positions of the starting point of the welding groove are obtained. A teaching example of the starting point detecting function is given. The algorithm is used to weld the plastics machinery frame. The research results of this paper are useful for the practical application of the starting point detecting function.

articleTitle: Analysis on task scheduling operating mechanism of embedded real-time operating system MQX
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The performance of task scheduling is one of the key factor that affects embedded real-time operating system's performance. This paper describes the realization mechanism of priority-based preemptive scheduling of MQX and the simple and efficient scheduling process of MQX based on in-depth analysis on task scheduling source code starting from MQX task descriptor, task template and data structure of task array and finally makes a comparison with μC/OS-II and makes a conclusion of fast execution speed of interrupt response and less time of context switch in MQX. This paper lays a foundation for the application and development and further in-depth research of MQX.

articleTitle: Research on the method of wind speed interpolation based on spatially anisotropic analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: By analyzing the spatially anisotropy of 10-minute average wind speed data from 299 automatic weather observing stations in Jilin Province, this paper put forward a new nested variogram model based on a multiple-direction analysis and conducted data interpolation with Ordinary Kriging method in both nested model and traditional single model. Based on a comparative analysis, the nested model is proved to be more accurate in wind speed interpolation.

articleTitle: Research of tracked vehicle's load spectrum test and build method
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In tracked vehicles, the power system's narrow pace and the high rotating power shaft lead to test load difficult. In this paper, the wireless testing device and clamping ring type torque sensor are designed to solve this problem. The Weibull function is used to test the load spectrum's probability distribution. The frequency spectrums are calculated by a new rain- flow counting method. Finally, the different levels load spectrum areset up for tracked vehicle,s design and test.

articleTitle: Research on performance of phase discriminator in code tracking loop inside spaceborne distance measurement transceiver
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To completely compare the performance of some widely used discriminators in code tracking loop, working range, discriminate gain, noise performance, tracking accuracy and computational load were considered. Three common discriminate formulas were derived based on DLL (delay lock loop), and then detailed analyses of performance were done. The results of simulation show that the working range and discriminate gain both decrease when the CNR (carrier to noise ratio) decreases, while the working range increases with the early-to-late correlator space increases, and the tracking accuracy decreases first and then increase when the early-to-late correlator space decreases. The conclusions drawn from this paper can be used to design the discriminator of transceiver.

articleTitle: Weak boundedness of timed continuous Petri nets
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper presents the concepts of weak boundeness and weak conservativeness for general timed continuous Petri nets with infinite server semantics. Based on the reduction technique and the linear algebra of matrices, a timed continuous Petri net with joins can be transformed to a join-free type with the equivalent dynamics of their markings. We endeavor to improve the link between piecewise linear systems, timed continuous Petri nets, and dynamics properties. The weak boundeness and weak conservativeness of the type nets are characterized by the inequalities of the matrix measure that defines the dynamics properties of the markings.

articleTitle: A new data link layer protocol for satellite IP networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper analyze the development trend of the satellite communications, describe the existing data link layer protocol of the Satellite Networks network and conclude the characteristics and impact of the satellite network, then a new satellite network data link layer protocol (NSLP) has been proposed. The comparison shows that the new protocol can effectively reduce the link layer header overhead and improve the efficiency of information transmission. In practical applications, the new protocol can simplify the data link layer functions, have a better compatibility with the TCP/IP protocol and higher IP protocol coupling degree, save resources on star and many other advantages. The new protocol has a benefit to effectively enhance the overall performance of the satellite IP networks.

articleTitle: Application of two-tuples linguistic group decision-making method to the warehouse location problem
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Considering that the factors affecting the warehouse location decision are difficult to quantify, the twotuples linguistic group decision-making method was used to analyze the warehouse location decision problem. At first, the location evaluation index system was established, the definition and aggregation operator of the method were analyzed, then the location decision procedure using two-tuples linguistic group decision-making method was designed. At last, an example with ten candidate locations was studied to illustrate the problem. The comprehensive evaluation value of the ten locations were calculated, the final warehouse location was determined via sorting the values. The result proved the effectiveness of the two-tuples linguistic group decision- making method.

articleTitle: An extendable markup language based intelligent electrical consumption information verification and self-error-recovery system
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: At present, one of the hottest topics of constructing the electrical power system is to complement the intelligent electrical consumption information model. It can help to enable the interactions between suppliers and consumers seamlessly. However, verification and correction of information under the standard model become important issues due to heterogeneous information structures. Therefore for overcoming misunderstanding and correcting errors in the information according to the standard information model, this paper proposes an extendable markup language based information verification and error self-recovery system with functions of model extraction, model conversion, data verification and error correction. The algorithm of system modules can process data with highly functionalities based on schema concept. The experimental results show that the system has excellent data adaption and working abilities.

articleTitle: Imaging simulation modeling for millimeter wave synthetic aperture imaging radiometer in near-field
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Due to the fact that theoretical analysis and instrument construction for antenna array of synthetic aperture imaging radiometer (SAIR) are both complicated, and designers usually hope to predict the imaging effect and analysis the influence of the parameters of SAIR before the system design. The simulation is a very useful method in the system design of SAIR. This paper is devoted to establishing an accurate imaging model of near-field millimeter wave SAIR for simulating the imaging process that include target radiating electromagnetic wave, antenna collecting target radiation and transforming them into RF signal, and antenna array collecting the visibility function. By using the equivalent complex baseband signals to represent the practical target radiation and RF signals in time domain, the efficiency of this simulation model is improved significantly. Some characteristics of near-filed millimeter wave SAIR are verified by a series of simulation experiments, and the effectiveness of this imaging model is tested by these simulation experiments. Results of the imaging simulation experiment show that this model is an efficient, feasible imaging model for near-field millimeter wave SAIR.

articleTitle: Situation awareness method based on ontology and evidence theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The fusion and reasoning of multi-source heterogeneous information is important and difficult in the research of situational awareness. In this paper, the advantages of ontology in certainty reasoning and the advantages of evidence theory in uncertainty reasoning are combined, situation model and reasoning decision algorithm based on ontology and evidence theory is proposed. The model effectively integrates the theory of evidence and ontology, and results that the situational awareness model has strong adaptability. Experimental results show that the proposed method can be easily used in the situation ontology modeling of multi-source heterogeneous information, and effectively improve the accuracy of the inference results.

articleTitle: Thermal analysis software design and implementation applied in line focusing solar collector
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the implementation process of the software which can analyze the thermal performance of the line focusing solar collector. The paper focused on the mathematical model and the algorithm of the software. Heat-collecting analytic software uses least squares to solve the problem of the multiple high order equations. Finally the software is completed using the Matlab GUI.

articleTitle: A novel parallel interference cancellation scheme for OFDM in time-varying underwater acoustic channels
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems are sensitive to channel variations caused by motility, which introduce inter-carrier interference (ICI). In this paper, a novel parallel interference cancellation (PIC) scheme is proposed to deal with ICI for OFDM in time-varying underwater acoustic channels (UWAC). The key idea is to estimate and remove ICI from the received signal before equalization in each iterative process. Meanwhile, ICI estimation, is achieved via time-varying channel estimation based on a piece-wise linear model where time-variations information is extracted from adjacent symbols. Moreover, PIC method is introduced to further refine the performance of channel estimation and equalization. Avoiding inversion of channel gain matrix, the proposed scheme has the best performance-complexity tradeoff compared with the existing methods. Simulation results demonstrate its good performances of ICI mitigation, bit error rate (BER), and robustness against UWAC.

articleTitle: Anti-jamming decision-making in wireless communication based on Rough Sets Theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper proposed anti-jamming decision-making rules extraction algorithm of wireless communication based on Rough Sets (RS) Theory. Firstly, we compress the enormous decision space and establish a relatively reduced decision-making system. Secondly, we adopt a kind of heuristic algorithm to reduce condition attributes, on this basis, we removed some redundant attribute values under the case of guaranteeing the classification capacity of the decision-making system unchanged, then, we acquire general decision rules. Furthermore, based on the power minimum criteria we could get specific decision rules. Simulation results illustrate that decision-making based on the RS Theory could acquire efficient decision rules which could realize decision-making with low complexity.

articleTitle: Relay selection and power allocation for energy saving cooperative wireless networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A novel single relay selection scheme in cooperative wireless network is provided. Our scheme first chooses a best relay from a set of N available relays and then uses the selected relay to cooperate between the source and destination. The relay selection method was considered both instantaneous channel state information and residual energy information. Specially, cooperation communication will be provoked only when data transmission on the directed link fails so that overheads cooperative relay brings will be cut down. Moreover, power allocation is studied under a more realistic circumstance where the maximum transmission power of each node is constrained. Analysis of outage probability shows that our scheme achieves the same diversity-multiplexing tradeoff as achieved by more complex protocols and simulation results show that the scheme not only improves performance significantly, but also prolongs the network lifetime considerably.

articleTitle: The COD predictive technique based on neural network
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A new online COD predictive technique is proposed in this paper for sewage treatment plants. The technique utilizes the BP neural network method and Elman neural network method to build a model and adopts the real operating data of a chemical industry to establish the model for training and simulation. The results of the simulations indicate that the process variables can be achieved through the establishment of the network model and a reasonable choice of the auxiliary input variable in the complex systems of online prediction.

articleTitle: A new SNR improving method of HPRF-PD radar quasi-continuous wave processing
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Inverse receiver is often used in High Pulse Repetition Frequency-Pulse Doppler (HPRF-PD) radar. In such kind of system, the echo wave passes the narrow band filter of the receiver, and becomes quasi-continuous wave. When using the digital IF receiver to realize quasi-continuous wave processing, the receiver outputs zero value during the forcing closure of transmit-receiver switch. This method can reduce the output noise effectively and improve the output signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) accordingly because the duty factor of HPRF-PD radar is high. In the paper, the improvement of SNR is analyzed theoretically, and the simulation experiment verifies the validity of the method.

articleTitle: A parameter estimation algorithm using AR spectrum and STFT of hybrid modulated signal
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Through analyzing a new kind of FSK/PSK hybrid modulated signal, this paper promotes a parameter estimate algorithm. The algorithm combined the AR spectrum and Short Time Fourier Transform (STFT). It split the hybrid signal into independent Costas signals, and then figured out the parameters. The algorithm does not need to preprocess the hybrid signal by squaring, which helps keep the original SNR. Extensive Monte Carlo simulation results indicated that the algorithm has less calculation amount and higher estimation precision, which is close to the Cramer-Rao lower bound.

articleTitle: Optimal damping algorithm design in inertial navigation system
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to restrain the Schuler oscillation in inertial navigation system (INS), external velocity measurement was used as a reference to design optimal damping algorithm based on the Kalman filter. The error models of INS horizontal loops were studied according to its control model and Kalman filters were adopted to estimate the platform misalignment errors, velocity errors and gyro drift. Then based on the optimal control thought, feedback correction algorithm was designed and the estimate was put forward to damp Schuler oscillation and Foucault oscillation. Compared with the traditional damping network, optimal damping algorithm developed the transient response characteristics, in addition it could be used to estimate and compensate gyro drift. Simulation results shown that this algorithm could effectively suppress the Schuler oscillation and improve accuracy of inertial navigation system.

articleTitle: Clustering based blind estimation of PN sequences in M-ary spread spectrum system
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of blind estimation of the pseudo-noise(PN) sequence in M-ary spread spectrum system(MSSS), this paper learned from the idea of unsupervised clustering analysis, then proposed a method of estimating PN sequences in M-ary spread spectrum system based on K-means clustering algorithm. In this method, the MSSS signal was divided into non-overlapped individuals to construct a data set, the blind synchronization of the PN sequence was completed by the detection statistic of the data set's autocorrelation matrix; then the PN sequences set's scale was estimated by searching the cost function based on K-means clustering algorithm, the cost function's graph exhibited a significant inflection point,its position indicated the scale of PN sequences set; Finally the PN sequences was estimated by exploiting the clustering property of the data set. Theoretical analysis and computer simulations show that this method can accurately estimate the time delay and PN sequences in MSSS.

articleTitle: An open Web-based integrated system for intelligent building
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to enhancing the management and intelligence level of intelligent building, we analyze the development path of integration technology and propose a fully open Web-based integrated system. We also describe the key technologies of the system and evaluate it in our platform. The result shows that this integrated model can achieve the ultimate goal of building management system; we can use it as the ultimate form of building integration.

articleTitle: Realization of speech processing and recognition system based on digital signal processor
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: 16-bit fixed-point high-speed chip TMS320VC5402 and audio interface chip TLV320AIC10 are adopted in this paper, by which collecting, filtering and compressing data are processed. Final data are put into computer through serial port and received by MATLAB to complete playback, coding, recognition and simulation. Floating-point operation is realized on fixed-point digital signal processor, which has higher precision in calculation and wider signal processing dynamic range comparing with fixed-point realization. The experimental results show that rate of continuous word speech recognition is more than 92%. The new system has advantage of small size, low cost and high scalability, which can be applied to many specific occasions, such as the speech controlling toys and access control system.

articleTitle: Research of speaker recognition based on the weighted fisher ratio of MFCC
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Feature extraction and pattern recognition are two important technologies of speaker recognition system. We introduced the existing speaker recognition technology in this paper, proposed and implemented a speaker recognition algorithm based on the weighted fisher ratio of MFCC. Compared with the traditional feature selection methods, the characteristic vector obtained via this algorithm has the greatest degree of differentiation in the same dimension. To evaluate performance of this algorithm, we built a small speaker recognition system based on the MATLAB. According to the test results, the speaker recognition algorithm we proposed in this paper, can significantly increase the accuracy rate of training and recognition, and reduce the data required by calculation, in the case of keeping a higher recognition rate.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of portable terminal power management system based on ARM
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The power consumption of embedded portable terminal increases with its increasing functions. Power management scheme becomes an important concern in embedded applications. In this paper, aiming at implementing a power management system with low power-consuming, small packing and stable performance on embedded portable terminal, we analyze the power supply requirements in different modes according to its hardware structure, propose different power management policies when system is in different modes, design and implement the power management system based on ARM combining software with hardware. At last, we measure the system power consumption in the different conditions, measurement results indicate that the power management system implemented in this paper meets the design requirements, can provide the embedded portable terminal with reliable power supply.

articleTitle: Detection method of complex event based on the similarity of matching results
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The research of complex event is a fresh branch of the field of data mining. The detection of complex event can help people obtain useful information from masses of data, therefore, it has received much attention and research. Nowadays, There has been some basic methods and technologies for detecting complex events, however, more and more different kinds of datasets are produced by DAE(Data Acquisition Equipment), which presents a challenge for limited memory and traditional detecting techniques. Based on that, this essay proposes a kind of universal event model to express data gathered by different equipments and the structure of Event Tree to compress event instances in memory, which can make limited memory store more event instances. By analyzing the similarity of matching results, new detection method was proposed based on shared subsequences of matching results. This detection method can make the best of shared subsequences between matching result sequences to construct new result sequences, which can reduce output delay and improve the efficiency of detecting complex event.

articleTitle: A new intuitionistic fuzzy c-means clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper presents a new intuitionistic fuzzy c-means (IFCM)clustering algorithm by adapting a new method to calculate the hesitation degree of data point in cluster. From the definition of fuzzy entropy, if a clustering result of a data point has bigger fuzzy entropy, the clustering result should have more uncertainty. It means that we have insufficient information to deal with the clustering of a data point, so the hesitation degree of clustering result of the data point should be greater. Form this opinion, a mathematical model is applied to calculate the hesitation degree of clustering of data point based on fuzzy entropy is given. An IFCM clustering algorithms is present. Experiments are performed using two-dimensional synthetic data-sets referred from previous papers. Results have shown that proposed algorithm is not only effective for linear and nonlinear separation, but also able to describe more information comparing to fuzzy c-means clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: A Noval Multiple-Port Converter for high power satellite platform
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In a satellite, the main function of a Power Conditioning Unit (PCU) is to manage the energy coming from several power sources (usually photovoltaic and battery) and to deliver it continuously to the loads in an appropriate form during the overall mission. A Noval Multiple-Port Converter(MPC) used as high power PCU is proposed in this paper. The proposed converter merges photovoltaic port, bidirectional battery port and regulated power bus port into single power stage. The power conversion stages of MPC topology are first descried. The operation stages of converter and design of the circuit considerations are analyzed. Then the dynamic modeling and close loop design are also given as well. A competitive unit is used to realize priority of the regulated power bus. It is difficult to design intersecting closed control loop without proper decoupling method. Simulation and experimental results verify the proposed topology and confirm its ability to achieve independent control over three power processing paths. This topology promised significant savings in component count and losses for the future high power and high power density ratio satellite platform.

articleTitle: A novel overall adaptive algorithm for maneuvering target tracking
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: An adaptive tracking filter is proposed to enhance the tracking performance of maneuvering target. After analyzing the drawback of input estimation, an assumption that acceleration over detection window is linear-distributed is made. The assumption greatly looses the constant input constraint and makes input estimation with long detection window size applicable. The filter modal of input estimation based on linear acceleration assumption is deduced. Combined with innovation modification technique, the modified algorithm is more robust and adaptive. Simulations results verify that the modified IE performs better than original IE in tracking of maneuvering target with variable acceleration.

articleTitle: Research and improvement of LEACH algorithm based on power communication
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Combined with the application of wireless sensor networks(WSN) for smart grid, this paper constructs the energy model of WSN, analyzing the principle and implementation method of Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy(LEACH) algorithm. In consideration of characteristics of power communication, this paper pointed out weakness of the LEACH algorithm and proposed another improved SG-LEACH algorithm, in which the nodes are divided into common nodes and senior nodes, and the senior nodes can be elected as cluster head nodes with top priority. The simulation results show that SG-LEACH algorithm can effectively average energy consumption, significantly extends node survival time, and improves the transmission efficiency of the network.

articleTitle: Flexible L1 cache optimization for a low power embedded system
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Large power consumption of memory access has been one of the major bottlenecks in modern embedded systems. Because caches even take about half of those systems' power consumption. So it is essential in concentrating on optimized strategies for cache's parameters as well as the enhancement of its adaptability to various applications. Considering the particular applications of embedded systems, we can optimize the caches with configuration parameters such as cache size, line size or associativity. In this paper, we firstly put forward the relations between those cache parameters, and the quantified results establish a new reconfigurable cache structure so as to find the optimal cache parameters rapidly by a searching algorithm. Furthermore, the possible hardware implementation with certain parameters is described, and the effectiveness of this method is verified by experiments using CACTI6.5 and SPEC2006 benchmark on Simple-scalar 3.0e. Experimental results show that the proposed cache can reduce the power consumption to 38.4% of its maximum power consumption caused by the redundant hardware resources.

articleTitle: Design and research of intelligent control system for heating network flows
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: An expert fuzzy controller is designed, which is applied into the heating network flow control system to achieve the uniform heating purposes. The quantization factor, scale factor and fuzzy rules of conventional fuzzy controller are adjusted online by using the expert system to improve the steady-state accuracy and dynamic performance of the system. The results of matlab simulation indicate that the performance of the design is better than conventional PID controller and the conventional fuzzy controller.

Author Keywords: Average temperature of second supply and backwater

articleTitle: Localized Search Space design in Enhanced Physical Downlink Control Channel
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on investigating localized Search Space (SS) design in Enhanced Physical Downlink Control Channel (EPDCCH), which is introduced in Long Term Evolution advanced system to meet the requirements of frequency selective scheduling gain and beamforming gain. Since EPDCCH is frequency-division-multiplexed with downlink data channel, blocking probability is a very important issue in addition to resource utilization efficiency. This paper proposes the innovative methods of allowing different localized EPDCCH candidates to distribute to different Physical Resource Block (PRB) pairs, considering the capacity of control channel and the control resource overhead. By simulation results, it is proven that the proposed methods could get lower blocking probability while maintain the same UE complexity in Blind Decoding (BD).

articleTitle: Radome BSE measurement system based on adaptive axial tracking
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Boresight error (BSE) is an important parameter in evaluating radome electrical property. In this paper, a radome BSE measurement system based on null-seeking method is represented, which can track radome electrical axis adaptively. In this system, transmitting antenna can be controlled to move horizontally, while the system can track the axial shift of undertest receiving antenna influenced by radome automatically and record the shift distance. The test results proved that the system based on adaptive axial-tracking algorithm can reduce the scanning range of transmitting antenna effectively and improve the measuring efficiency.

articleTitle: An analytical design of GAPIDNN algorithm for AQM
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A PID Neural Network algotithm with genetic algorithm, called GAPIDNN, is designed and applied in active queue management (AQM). The genetic algorithm is used to turn the PID Neural Network weight. NS simulation results show that the GAPIDNN algorithm has better control performance than PIDNN. GAPIDNN algorithm shows higher robustness and link utilization under changing network enviroment and large delay.

articleTitle: Estimation of area of uncertainty for moving target tracking
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: On the assumption that measurement errors of range and bearing are zero-mean and Gaussian distributed, a method of estimating the moving target's likely position or AOU(Area Of Uncertainty) is presented based on the estimation of motion parameters. It exploits least square method to estimate the error of initial location vector and displacement vector. Through vectors synthesis of two kind of location error, precise expressions of confidence ellipse have been derived with 2-dimentional joint probability density function.
