GSMM characterize the inherent correlations among multiple labels by Hilbert-Schmidt independence criterion. It's expected to derive the optimal assignment of class membership to unlabeled samples by maximizing the consistency of class label correlations and simultaneously as smooth as possible on sample feature graph. The experiments comparing GSMM to the state-of-the-art multi-label learning approaches on several real-world datasets show GSMM can effectively learn from the labeled and unlabeled samples. Especially when the labeled is relatively rare, it can improve the performance greatly.

articleTitle: Applied multi-object tracking algorithm based on inverse linear quadratic theory to artificial robot
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Considering to the coupling problem of robot system in multi-target tracking, the control method and its algorithm steps based on the inverse linear quadratic (ILQ) is proposed in this paper. Under the method, the optimal feedback matrix and adjustment coefficient of controlled system is solved by the expected closed-loop poles and state space equations, which makes the robot control system be asymptotic stability and robust. On this basis, the force trajectory simulation of robot movement is done.

articleTitle: Reduced order aerodynamics for delta wing pitching oscillations
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: An unsteady aerodynamic reduced order model (ROM) based on Volterra Series is presented to identify the aerodynamics of a pitching delta wing. The wavelet multi-resolution analysis is employed to truncate the identification parameters. The identifications of unsteady aerodynamics are carried out in various cases with different mean angles of attack and oscillation amplitude. The results show that the second order nonlinear component of the responses appears in the cases with larger mean angle of attack and/or oscillation amplitude. This nonlinear component suppresses the oscillation amplitude of the aerodynamic responses. The first-order ROM capture the linear component exactly, but have no identification ability for the nonlinear component. Comparatively, The second-order ROM is capable of recognizing both linear and the second-order nonlinear component and significantly improve the prediction accuracy of aerodynamics with higher mean angle of attack and larger oscillation amplitude. In addition, the wavelet multi-resolution analysis is helpful to obtain the low-order approximation of Volterra Series and reduces the algorithm complexity.

articleTitle: A design of monitoring softwarefor distributed optical fiber sensing of methane
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Optical fiber sensing of methane is a new kind of gas detecting method based on spectral absorption technology. The method has lots of advantages, such as good sensitivity, high precision, less calibration, so that it's more and more widely used in industrial production. In order to match the requirements of hardware detecting system, this paper presents a design of monitoring software for distributed optical fiber sensing of methane based on VB development environment. This design can make methane concentration obtained by sensing probes of lower computer showed on the interface of upper computer in real time, and can export the data report. Meanwhile, it can send out alerting signal and fix the stoppage position quickly when stoppage happens. This paper introduces the following aspects in detail, the establishment of communication protocol, the design of data base, the design and realization of interface.

articleTitle: Double-loop networked control system of DC motor based on dynamic smith predictor and Fuzzy-PI controller
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The double-loop control system of DC motor based on network is investigated in this paper. System configuration consists of the real-time network and three intelligent nodes. In order to overcome the network-induced time delay, the dynamic Smith predictor and Fuzzy-PI hybrid control strategy are proposed respectively while designing the current and speed loop. Finally, simulation platform based on Matlab/Simulink and TrueTime toolbox is established. Taking different delay upper bounds into account, the dynamic responses of speed and armature current is given and analyzed. Simulation results show that system has excellent dynamic characteristics and robustness when the network random delay upper bound is less than one second. The effectiveness of control method proposed in this paper provides a reference for other networked cascade control system.

articleTitle: Packet delay estimation with minimum FIFO block based on asymmetric PTP network
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The symmetry of packet delay is one of basic assumption of PTP (Precision Time Protocol). But most existing networks could not meet this assumption to achieve high accuracy PTP synchronization. The FIFO block is one of main reasons that lead packet delay asymmetry according to the research. So the packet delay estimation with minimum FIFO block is put forward to try to select those “lucky packets” which survived from FIFO block in packet stack to achieve good PTP performance. The boundary conditions of this algorithm is decided by the mean time interval using to select “lucky packets”. Its expression has been deduced. Verified by some meaningful tests, in the asymmetry network, the accuracy of packet delay estimation increases almost 25ns with stability increasing almost 2 order, and the accuracy of PTP synchronization increases more than one-fold with stability increasing almost four-fold, compared with no optimization.

Author Keywords: symmetry of packet delay between master and slave

articleTitle: An efficient evaluation scheme for remote sensing images
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: During image post processing, the restoration operation is required to increase the quality of the image. According to traditional evaluation methods, the evaluated object is the whole image. Obviously, some image details are not favorable for quality evaluation, unfortunately, these maybe cause evaluation error. Furthermore, it is inefficient because of lots of computation for entire image. In this paper, we puts forward using a specified region of interest (ROI) to evaluate the image quality instead of whole image. The experimental results show that, the selection method of the specified ROI is effective, and the evaluation result is consistent with the objective evaluation of entire image.

articleTitle: Urban Freight Service Capacity Integrated Display System
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Urban Logistics Information Platform (LIP) provides all kinds of logistics information. However, LIP hardly integrates any form of historical or real-time urban traffic information. Hence the regulatory authority could not carry out the agile regulation on urban freight transport. This paper designed a general Urban Freight Service Capacity Integrated Display System (UFSC-IDS) by UML and JFreeChart and illustrated with Beijing, and accordingly proposed the Urban Freight Service Capacity Dynamic Coordination System (UFSC-DCS) based on Matlab Java Builder. The UFSC-DCS effectively supported the transportation agencies dynamically regulate permits of freight trucks access municipal areas to make full use of the road network capacity as well as meet the urban freight demand.

articleTitle: The research of pulp fiber cross separation processing
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The purpose of the research is to solve the current problems of inaccurate separation of overlapping objects, operation of the influence on the measurement of single target object and the error is large .Due to the properties of pulp fibers, this paper provides an accurate and automatic method of detecting cross fibers and isolating fibers from the pulp fiber under noises. In this paper, a off-the-shelf scanner is used to generate a grayscale image of multiple fibers followed by customized image processing algorithms that compute the length of each fiber in the image. So an automatic method to separate cross fiber in pulp fiber accurately, analyse the geometrical characteristics of the intersection or cross section is put forward. In this method finding and marking the intersection or cross section, and then using the fiber edge and skeleton near the intersection or cross section of the continuity and differentiability come ture.Finally calculating the average slope will be done. Experiments in VC++6.0 show that the proposed method is efficient in separating the corss fibers accurately.

articleTitle: Effective tracking and tracing in RFID-enabled supply chain networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: An RFID-enabled supply chain network facilitates tag tracing and tracking by means of sharing data in infrastructures of Information Services (IS) or Discovery Services (DS), throughout the whole life-cycle of a tag. EPCGlobal [1] is a widely applied standard for an RFID-enabled supply chain network, which defines the lifecycle management of an EPC tag, by describing the tracking and tracing issues in an EPCGlobal network. However, existing tracking and tracing algorithms do not consider complicated events defined in EPCGlobal standards, such as aggregation, disaggregation, recall, remark, etc. This paper defines an EPCGlobal standard compatible model of RFID-enabled supply chain network, which introduces EPC tag tracking and tracing in context of complicated events. We propose effective tracing and tracking algorithms based on that model. Experiments using simulated data demonstrate that the complexity of our algorithm is linear to n.

articleTitle: An equivalence checking algorithm based on cutset match of gate-level circuits
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In design process of digital circuits, an equivalence checking algorithm is proposed on cut-set match of a gate-level circuit in order to improve the correctness of the circuit design and time and space efficiency of verification. Firstly of all, the specification and implementation circuits are divided into several set-cuts, which are called logic cones in accordance with partition rules. Secondly, cut-sets of two circuits are matched using matching techniques. Thirdly, an “exclusive-or” gate is connected to outputs of the two matched cut-sets, then the miter circuit is constructed, and the structure is changed to the corresponding conjunctive normal formula. Finally, the miter circuit is proven to be functionally equivalent or not by using the engine of SAT. Experimental results show the feasibility of the approach on the ISCAS'85 benchmark circuits.

articleTitle: A design and simulation of HLA based on MDA
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The combination of MDA and HLA is a need for HLA development. In this paper, MDA-based HLA simulation Framework is put forward .The Domain partition of such framework is analyzed in detail. In that framework, RTI is regard as a sub domain in the service domain, not a platform as usual. But it is more benefit for the model reusability. At last, the integration method of RTI domain models and application models is provided. This method is a new thought for the application of MDA in HLA.

articleTitle: ISCSI-based data protection system for virtual machine
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Virtual Machine (VM) has been commonly used in the software testing environments. Since this environments are unstable, we propose the ISCSI-Based Protection System to ensure the high availability of VM, which can recover the damaged VM files to the past state. Our system is carried out at block level on standard ISCSI protocol and snapshot. Using CDC (content-defined chunking) de-duplication, we improve the utilization rate of space. Specially, we enhance the flexibility of managing disks with LVM (Logical Volume Manager). Through running a variety of VMs with different configurations, we demonstrate that the VM can be recovered quickly and we also reduce the storage space effectively. Furthermore, making use of ISCSI achieves stable and no distance limitation remote storage without too much investment.

articleTitle: Research on hull attitude adjustment method based on parameters optimization
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, we focus on the optimization design of torsion bar spring of the suspension system based on virtual prototype and parametric optimum techniques in order to satisfy the modification requirement of the high speed tracked vehicle. Through the virtual validation for the optimized results, our proposed optimized algorithm is prove to be feasible and provide a novel research view for the modification design of the high-speed tracked vehicle.

articleTitle: Design of ultrasonic ranging instrument based on DSP
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The development process of ultrasonic ranging instrument based on DSP has been introduced. The integrated design block diagram, main schematic diagrams and software flowchart are illustrated. Finally, accuracy of results produced by the ultrasonic ranging instrument is verified and analyzed. The proposed ranging instrument has been added with the temperature compensation circuit, which calculates the acoustic speed under the actual temperature using the acoustic speed compensation equation. As a result, the instrument's accuracy is further improved.

articleTitle: A dynamic memory management model on Xen virtual machine
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Xen visualization has been widely used in cloud computing, data center and cyber physical systems. Because memory can not be used by time-sharing as other devices, how to efficiently allocate memory has become the bottleneck of performance improvement on Xen. In this paper, we propose a dynamic memory management model on Xen virtual machine with the goal of availability growth, which includes a fast memory adjustment strategy with memory recycling, memory increasing, and memory adjustment. Experimental results show that, in order to satisfy the memory requirements virtual machines need, this memory management model can recycle a large amount of free memory in virtual machines rapidly; in the aspect of increasing memory, using exponential growth mode can also satisfy high memory requirements in a short time, which has improved availability of the virtual machine requiring memory urgently; and in the case of shortage of memory resources, the model can also give priority to meet the demand of virtual machine requiring memory urgently, which has avoided availability falling due to shortage of memory resources.

articleTitle: Design of typical waveform generator based on DDS/SOPC
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A waveform generator was designed based on DDS (Direct digital frequency synthesis) and SOPC (System on a Programmable Chip). DDS technology is used to generate sine wave, square wave, triangular wave, amplitude modulation wave and other signals. Using VHDL and C programming, the DDS module and Nios II soft-core processor are integrated into the FPGA chip to enhance the expansibility. This design is verified by synthesis and simulation through Quartus II. Experiments show that output frequency range is 0 ∼ 25.88 MHz, the voltage is 0 ∼ 3.64 V, and the resolution reaches 0.5 Hz when the waveform has no significant distortion.

articleTitle: Advanced algorithm of line landmarks labeling in mobile navigation based on PDA
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: According to the characteristics of mobile navigation based on PDA, the map scenes in the screens should be changed in real time, which needs to dynamically output map labels to adapt to these challenges. In this paper, the opposite Douglas algorithm is used for di viding dynamic segments based on line labels and obtaining smooth location of line features as the location of labels. The results obtained in this paper can be applied to solve the problems of ambiguous expressions and/or invisibility of labels of line features, achieving the unity of the integrity and aesthetics of the automated output.

articleTitle: Effectiveness evaluation of information fusion system oriented to fusion ability
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: When designing a special information fusion system (IFS), it is important to establish metrics and comprehensive assessment method as part of evaluation strategy. According to information processing flow in IFS, a new hierarchical metrics system was developed to evaluating system effectiveness after defining three fusion ability (FA). To reflect the uncertainty of qualitative metrics values by experts, effectiveness reliability model (ERM) was introduced, and the discounting evidence combination rule (DECR) was developed to deal with effectiveness reliability sets. A numerical example showes the proposed evaluation architecture is practical and a more reasonable result can be obtained by DECR when existing the conflict assessment.

articleTitle: Terrain rendering using regular mesh cell
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The earlier algorithm of rendering terrain focused on the terrain mesh only in GPU, and tried to send as less triangle as possible to display card. However, the model simplification and multi-level task cause GPU a lot of computation loads. In recent year, with the fast development of GPU capability, the bottleneck of terrain rendering system is CPU. In order to make full use of GPU capability, and package as many scattered triangles as possible to GPU in the same time, i.e. submit more triangles when transfer graphs to render functions, and decrease the transfer number of graph rendering function. Based on the above rules, this paper proposed a new method to render terrain layered structure, the relative location between layers keeps still, which is strict nested structure. The whole mesh structure is composed by the translation and zooming of a mesh cell. Before rendering terrain mesh, this mesh cell is compiled to OpenGL display list. Because the display list is only a number, so the transfer data amount is a little when rendering this mesh cell, which can greatly improve the rendering performance. When this mesh is in GPU, mesh construction in CPU is avoided by sampling height texture to obtain height value during the vertices tinter.

articleTitle: Riding comfort analysis for two degrees model for mannedl lunarv vehicle
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Two degrees of freedom of suspension vibration model was established for deployable manned lunar vehicle. Transfer characteristics and amplitude frequency characteristics of vibration response including body acceleration, suspension dynamic deflection and wheel relative dynamic load were obtained. Then lunar surface random excitation model in time domain was established according to the filtered white noise method. In order to analyze the affection of four parameters that is vehicle natural frequency, damping ratio, stiffness ratio and the mass ratio of two-degree system of manned lunar vehicle on mean square value of the vibration response, numerical integral approach was used to calculate. These provide theoretical basis for suspension design and riding comfort analysis for manned lunar vehicle.

Author Keywords: two degrees of freedon vibration system

articleTitle: Multi-sensor target tracking based on Gauss-Markove estimate
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: As measurements errors are assumed to be zero-mean, Gaussian distributed and uncorrelated, an improved method of target state estimation for multi-sensor target tracking is presented based on Gauss-Markove estimate. By minimizing the error covariance matrix, weighted least square method is exploited to obtain the Gauss-Markove estimate. Applying Gauss-Markove estimate to Kalman filter, the target state was estimated. The Monte-Carlo simulation results show that Gauss-Markove estimate can efficiently improve the accuracy of observations. The performance of proposed algorithm for state estimation is better than that with single sensor observations. Presented approach and obtained results may be useful in multi-sensor target tracking.

articleTitle: A synchronous blind equalization algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper discusses the synchronous blind equalization algorithm which combines the synchronization technology and the Blind equalization algorithm. We analysis the importance of the synchronization technology in the underwater acoustic (UWA) communication by these algorithms. The data receives interference when it passes a multipath channel in the UWA communication. The disturbed signal will cause error code at the receiving end. But if we use these synchronous blind equalization algorithms, the receiving end can receive the correct message, because the blind equalization algorithm can compensate the disturbed data and the synchronization technology can find the head of the send message. This paper will make the synchronization technology combines with the basic Constant Modulus Algorithm (CMA) and the T/4 space equalizer of CMA algorithm (T/4-CMA). Then we will discuss the feasibility of these algorithms by the theory and the characteristic of the blind equalization with or without the synchronization technology by the simulation. The foundation works have been established for the farther research.

articleTitle: Complex modal pseudo-excitation method for gust responses of wing structures
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: An accurate and efficient approach, which combines complex modal analysis with pseudo-excitation method, is proposed in this work to obtain the gust responses of wing structures. First, the motion equations of gust responses of a wing structure can be decoupled by the complex modal analysis. Then, pseudo-excitation method is used to transform random vibration problem into deterministic harmonic response analysis. The method can not only give the displacement response's PSD (power spectral density), but also the PSD of velocity response and the cross-PSD. A new integration formula which can give the statistical characteristics of responses at the fixed time point and can choose integration points in frequency domain to adapt more efficient integration scheme when solving the random responses of non-stationary random excitations is present. An example from aeronautical engineering demonstrates the high precision and efficiency of the method.

articleTitle: Contourlet domain watermarking algorithms based on Arnold scrambling and singular value decomposition
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Based on analyses of digital watermarking algorithm with Contourlet transform, a new Contourlet domain watermarking algorithm is proposed with the application of Arnold scrambling and singular value decomposition (SVD) strategy from two aspects of watermarking-preprocessing and embedding scheme. After the Contourlet transform, intermediate frequency sub-bands are decomposed to get singularity values, then watermarking scrambled with Arnold rule is dispersedly embedded into the SVD values, so as to improve the ability against attack. Experimental results show that, the proposed algorithm can not only strengthen the security of watermarking, but also equip with robustness against attacks such as noise and crop.

articleTitle: An improved differential evolution algorithm for reliability redundancy allocation problem
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, an improved differential evolution (IDE) algorithm with adaptive mechanism is proposed to solve the reliability redundancy allocation problem. This algorithm modifies scale factor, crossover rate. Experimental results over two benchmark problems demonstrate that proposed IDE has effectiveness and efficiency than other algorithm reported in literatures about the reliability redundancy allocation problem.

articleTitle: Out-of-sequence measurement algorithm based on fast Marginalized Particle Filter
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: When it comes to the Out-of-Sequence Measurement (OOSM) problem with nonlinear system, the particle filter (PF) is widely used. But these OOSM-PF algorithms are facing the computation burden. In order to reduce the storage and computation requirements, a new algorithm based on the fast Marginalized Particle Filter (FMPF) for the OOSM problem is proposed in this paper. By using this algorithm, the state vectors are divided into two parts: the nonlinear and linear parts. The OOSM-PF is used to deal with the nonlinear parts, while the linear parts are estimated by Kalman filter (KF) based algorithm. The algorithm solves the OOSM problem under the framework of forward directly updating. It can deal with both the 1-step-lag and the multistep lag OOSM problem. Theoretical and simulation results show the effectiveness of the algorithm in dealing with the OOSM problem.

articleTitle: Research on wireless sensor network optimization
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: When applying the environmental monitor platform, the wireless sensor network needs lowering energy consumption, enlarging the covering area, and increasing accuracy so that we can save cost and obtain long-term real-time effective data of environmental monitoring. Based on the overall design of environmental monitoring system platform, this essay researches relative covering models of wireless sensor network, such as Boolean Coverage Model and Truncated Coverage Model, and then designs the star-shaped deployment coverage model, so that the cost and coverage area optimization will be achieved. The experiment findings proved that the model could reduce nodes in reality and increase the coverage area, and be of significance to corresponding project application.

articleTitle: Dynamic association for load balancing in LTE multi-cell networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In the existing researches, switching users for load balancing often leads to aggressive handovers, which may take up plenty of resource in target cells, leading to higher Call Drop and Block Ratio (CDBR). In order to overcome this issue, our objective was to minimize the CDBR of the network and to achieve load balancing among neighboring cells. First we formulated the load balancing as an optimization problem and the objective was to minimize the CDBR of the network. Then a practical algorithm was proposed, which included handover conditions through analyzing the handover gain for switching users and call admission control. Extensive simulation shows that the proposed algorithm achieves better performance in CDBR and system resources occupation.

articleTitle: FPGA-based acceleration and deceleration control for CNC machine tools
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Solve the problem of the steady transition in CNC machine speed in the high speed machining during start and stop. Based on the linear interpolation algorithm of double-axis and two dimensional, a new control method for double-axis stepper motor accelerating and decelerating at the same time was put forward, and the hardware on FPGA was realized. By two stepper motors directed to X and Y controlled through a set of circular distributor and driving-circuit, a transition may be steady. The simulation result gave good control effect and showed the effectiveness of this algorithm.

articleTitle: A precision-tunable CFG reconstruction algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: CFG (Control Flow Graph) is the cornerstone of reverse analysis, and how to determine the targets of indirect jumps is a challenge for CFG reconstruction. Based on BRIL (Binary Reverse Intermediate Language) and standard abstract interpretation framework, a K-set abstract domain based on abstract memory model was adopted. Control flow and data flow analysis could be executed on this abstract domain simultaneously and iteratively until a fix point was reached. Experimental evidence shows that the precision degree and the time cost are changing with the value of K. As long as K is set appropriately, the CFG reconstruction algorithm can resume accurate CFG in a moderate costs, and the average false positive rate of indirect jump destination address is less than one (<1).

articleTitle: FPGA implementation of a L-band Digital Aeronautical Communications System (L-DACS1) physical layer(PHY)
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: L-DACS1 is the broadband candidate transmission scheme for the future L-band Digital Aeronautical Communication System. This paper reports on FPGA implementation of a L-DACS1 PHY. And technical specification and FPGA implementation feasibility of the PHY are verified. This paper's contributions include (i) FPGA implementation of a L-DACS1 PHY, (ii) the design of the L-DACS1 PHY tested on Xillinx platform.

articleTitle: Support interference corrections of a common research model with flying-wing configuration
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Since flying-wing configuration has excellent performance in aerodynamic, stealth capability and structure, it has become an ideal configuration of the future unmanned ah- vehicles. Compared with conventional airplane layout, the support interference effects and the local shape distortions are more obvious. Though the support effect is now accounted for in most wind tunnel procedures thanks to various correction methods, they call upon dedicated experiments which are expensive, complex and require the introduction of another support. Solving the steady Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes equations for complex configuration has become routine task in research and it has occasionally been used to investigate model support effects. In this paper, the flow field and force disturbance caused by the support was calculated by comparing simulations with and without support for several angles of attack at Mach number equals 0.9. Meanwhile, and amounts and regulations of support interference effects on forces and moments for this flying-wing model were obtained.

articleTitle: Image segmentation using a hybrid gradient based watershed transform
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A watershed transform segmentation method based on hybrid gradient that combines intensity and texture visual cues is proposed. Firstly a bilateral filtering method derived from robust statistics is used to extract the intensity gradient. Secondly a Gabor filter bank is applied to extract texture features. With a smoothing post process, the texture gradient is extracted. Then by morphological dilation and normalization process texture and intensity gradients are fused to form the hybrid gradient. At last the marked watershed transform on the hybrid gradient image is carried out to segment the image. The experiment results show that the proposed method is effective in generating accurate primitive-objects boundaries and meanwhile reducing the over segmentation of image.

articleTitle: Overcoming discontinuities inside waveguides with epsilon-near-zero medium
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: An approach to eliminate scattered fields due to discontinuities inside waveguide structures was introduced in this paper. The theory of squeezing electromagnetic energy in epsilon-near-zero medium (ENZ) was reviewed firstly. The essential distinction between zero-scattering fields due to ENZ and Fabry-Pérot thickness was stressed. Simulation results were then presented to verify the theoretical prediction. Finally, this paper proposed and verified with full wave electromagnetic simulations the first realization of a two-dimensional (2D) anisotropic ENZ with thin wire structures in a waveguide with a narrow channel.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of mobile digital campus based on mobile internet
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Mobile digital campus construction of Three Gorges University is taken as an example to discuss the meanings of mobile digital campus, and how to design and implement mobile digital campus. Mobile digital campus is a development direction, which can not be ignored in the construction of mobile digital campus in the future, and it promotes functions and really does effective extension for traditional digital campus. In this paper, from the beginning of construction of mobile digital campus of Three Gorges University, firstly, the importance and necessity is put forward for mobile digital campus, secondly, the whole architecture of mobile digital campus is designed, including WAP portal and relative interfaces, thirdly, implementation technology of mobile portal and mobile application are introduced, finally, analysis and consideration are raised from aspects of security and reliability, meanwhile, combined with practical experience, development direction is also discussed.

articleTitle: Experimental study on friction and wear performance of non-smooth brake surface
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The wear tests of brake friction pair with regularly distributed pits on brake disc surface were performed on the wear testing machine. The wear losses were measured by the L-200 photoelectric analytical balance. The experiment result shows that both the pits distance and the diameter have significant influences on the wear resistance, the non-smooth surface morphology also has influence on friction coefficient. The wear losses of the smooth surface and non-smooth surface are compared to analyze the friction and wear performance of non-smooth surface quantitatively. Analysis results show that friction and wear performance of non-smooth surface is better than that of smooth sample.

articleTitle: A novel hormone-based implicit coordination approach for manufacturing control system
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Aiming at handling dynamic and complex manufacturing environment, a novel coordination approach, inspired by the hormone regulatory mechanism, is proposed and applied to manufacturing control system in this paper. Inspired by the hormone regulatory principle, a novel coordination approach, which uses an implicit coordination approach, can find efficient routing paths among the manufacturing resources automatically. Using the proposed approach, the control communication overhead, which exists in shop floor control system, can be reduced. Through a suite of experiments, the proposed hormone-based implicit coordination approach has excellent control performance, lower communication, and better robustness.

articleTitle: A fast fusion approach of remote sensing images based on lifting wavelet
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Due to the problem that the process of traditional remote sensing fusion with large amount of data has poor real-time performance, a fast fusion approach of Panchromatic and Multispectral images based on lifting wavelet is proposed. Running speed is improved by the combination of lifting wavelet transform and fast IHS transform. Moreover, the complementarity of the two transform can improve the quality of the fused image. The experimental result indicates that the algorithm proposed in this paper can not only obtain a good fusion result, but also has a well real-time performance.

articleTitle: Study on tracking method based on infrared random point
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A new tracking method based on infrared random point is proposed, which has an advantage of tracking accuracy and nature. It can track and position any indoor flat object. An infrared laser projection device is designed to generate infrared random point. Infrared camera is used to get infrared image and LLAH algorithm is adopted in recognition. Experimental platform is set up. The stability of the tracking method based on infrared random points is verified by the actual test. Results show that the method in the process of tracking is hardly affected by shade and is not sensitive to the change of visible brightness. Even if the camera moves rapidly, object can be accurately identified.

articleTitle: A non-probabilistic approach to design of composite wings including uncertainties
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A non-probabilistic method is developed to optimize the design of an idealized composite wing through consideration of the uncertainties in the material properties, fiber-direction angle, and ply thickness. In the study, the collocation interval analysis method based on the first class Chebyshev polynomial approximation is presented to predict the upper bound and lower bound of the flutter speed. Compared with the interval analysis method based on the first order Taylor expansion, the proposed method is a non-gradient algorithm using several collocation points which improve the precision of results owing to better approximation of the flutter speed response function. A non-probabilistic reliability criterion is defined, indicating the non-probability of failure due to flutter, and is used to determine successfully the optimal design of the composite wing.

articleTitle: Integration of bottom-up and top-down cues in Bayesian network for object detection
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Automatic detection of objects in cluttered images involves a lot of uncertainty, and has been a great challenge in computer vision. However, humans can easily find their interested objects via the mechanisms of visual selective attention. Inspired by this, a visual attention model which integrates bottom-up and top-down cues in the Bayesian network is proposed. In this model, the bottom-up color and shape cues are combined with the top-down color and shape priors, and all these cues are related with their locations, simulating the convergence of bottom-up and top-down cues in visual area V4 of human visual system. Then, a Bayesian network is constructed according to these cues, and each cue is represented as a node in the network. Finally, a saliency map about localizing the target objects is created through the inference in the Bayesian network. The uncertainty in object detection is reduced by the inference greatly. The experiments show that this model can detect interested objects in images with complex backgrounds, even if the objects have different sizes, colors or shapes, and appear in different places of an image. In comparison with the results of famous Itti's visual attention model, the advantage of our model is that it can obtain the contours of objects, which is very helpful for further process of object recognition.

articleTitle: Research on equipment data management based on NXD
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Equipment information needs to be shared and exchanged in the heterogeneous systems. The traditional database did not adapt the new requirement. How to effectively manage the massive XML data is a problem to be solved urgently. The characteristic and advantage of data integration technology based on Native XML Database (NXD) were analyzed. A data management system of the equipment information based on NXD technology was proposed, and the system functions, architecture and key technologies were studied. In paper three primary technologies were discussed: data module, information storage and information interaction. After these research works, heterogeneous data is retrieved more quickly; efficiency of information management is enhanced and the interoperation of information is assured. And at the same time, the most important things are data integration and sharing problems have been effectively solved.

articleTitle: Generation and application of adaptive PEBI grid for numerical well testing(NWT)
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Several methods have been investigated on how to generate PEBI (Perpendicular Bisection) grid such as static property based method, flow based method and the combination of them. However, these methods are not suitable for NWT. In this paper, an adaptive gridding method is proposed for NWT based on the locations of the wells. First we divide the reservoir into several areas which each has one well in it. Then, PEBI grid points are placed in each area separately according to isobars which are derived from analytical solutions of the well in that area. At the end of this paper, proposed adaptive PEBI grid was compared with uniform coarse and fine grid. Numerical results in this paper showed that adaptive grid reduced two thirds of grid number and saved two thirds of computation time while kept almost same accuracy compared with fine grid.

articleTitle: Reduced rank calculation of space-time anti-jamming for navigation receiver
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Navigation receiver is easily influenced by radio frequency (RF) interference in complicated electromagnetic environment, so it is necessary to enhance its ability of cancelling interference. Space-time anti-jamming system model of the navigation receiver is established. Multistage Wiener filter and conjugate gradient iteration algorithms are researched, and their characteristics such as calculation and storage are analyzed. A new method of difference sample mean square error (DSMSE) is proposed to stop calculation timely. The simulation results show that the two algorithms are valid in space-time adaptive processing for navigation receiver, and the DSMSE method can stop calculation process when the anti-jamming performance of the algorithm almost reaches its best performance, avoiding extra computation and alleviating computational burden.

articleTitle: Complete analytical model based armored power grid fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The power system which is independent has been used in the modern new armored vehicle. This paper describes a method for the analysis of the armored power grid fault diagnosis. Taking into account the structure and characteristics of armored vehicle, a kind of complete analytic model which is considering the influence of each protection and the joint influence between the main and back-up protections applies to the system. This model uses the improved discrete Particle Swarm Optimization to solve the objective function. The Particle Swarm Optimization has better population diversity, convergence and global optimal ability. The example verification shows that the rationality and veracity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of comprehensive general support system for airborne inertial platform
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of guarantee equipment deficiency and poor versatility in airborne inertial platform system, and adopting ATE design ideas, this paper presents a design scheme of comprehensive general support system based on PXI bus architecture. Putting forward the classified switching technology, hardware resources are made of reasonable extension, thus it realizes the integrated support of platform of INS and SINS. Adopting the virtual technology, software architecture of support platform are hierarchical, modular and interface. Thus, it realizes the integrated control of test system. Adopting improved generalized likelihood ratio method reduces the system undetected rate and false alarm rate. The practice has proved that this support platform has the advantage of stable operation, good versatility, strong practicality and broad application prospects.

articleTitle: A noise reduction method for speech signal combining ICA-R and EMD-wavelet
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A novel noise reduction method combining ICA-R and EMD-wavelet is proposed in this paper. Because the single channel ICA is an extreme ill-condition problem in mathematics, which common ICA is incapable to solve, we exploited the Empirical mode decomposition (EMD) technique to expand the single channel received signal into several intrinsic mode functions (IMFs). The noise is suppressed through two steps, first, wavelet threshold denoising is applied to the frontal two IMFs, second, the signal and the remaining noise are separated by ICA-R. The reference signal is constructed by the low frequency IMFs, helping ICA-R to extract the object speech signal. Simulation results indicate the proposed method can recovery the speech signal from noisy signal effectively, especially when noise-to-signal ratio is high.

articleTitle: Path selection algorithm based on Grey Incidence Decision
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Most drivers often make route choices according to their preferences in our real life, and they have different requirements for different path attributes. In this paper, the problem for optimal path selection with driver's preference is studied and path selection algorithm based on Grey Incidence Decision is put forward. Firstly, a path selection index system was constructed in order to reflect the driver's preference. Analytic Hierarchy Process was used to calculate the driver's preference coefficient for the path. Secondly, since the process of path selection in Route Guidance System is complex and contains a lot of “grey” information, the method based on Grey Incidence Decision was proposed to sort paths. Finally, an actual network was used to simulate, the combination of Analytic Hierarchy Process and Grey Incidence Decision searched the optimal path reflecting driver's preferences. The simulation results show that the proposed path selection algorithm has good feasibility and applicability.

articleTitle: Spatial time-frequency MUSIC algorithm in α stable distribution noise environment
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The α stable distribution has been suggested as a more appropriate model in the field of Direction of Arrival(DOA) estimation of non-stationary array signals processing. DOA estimation mean-squared error(MSE) of ROC-MUSIC, FLOM-MUSIC based on Fractional Low Order Moment(FLOM) matrices and STF-MUSIC based on Spatial Time-Frequency Matrices(STFDM) was greater in low GNSR α stable distribution environment, resolution was lower. Hence, a new Time-Frequency FLOM-MUSIC(TF-FLOM-MUSIC) method employed FLOM-STFDM was proposed, procedures of algorithm was introduced in this paper. Simulations show that the technique demonstrate the advantages in terms of resolution and MSE than TF-MUSIC and FLOM-MUSIC, was robust.

articleTitle: Design of an L-band PLL frequency synthesizer
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In modern communication technology, frequency source is a very important part of communication system. This paper designs a frequency source with an output frequency of 1GHz based on Phase-locked Loop (PLL) frequency synthesis technology. First of all, it introduces the principle of PLL frequency synthesis technology. And as the important parts of this system, third-order passive RC loop filter and output matching network are presented. Later, simulation results are achieved by Advanced Design System (ADS) software. Then, the process of software design is presented. Finally, the circuit board is produced and tested. Experiment results show that the power of PLL can reach -5dBm and its phase noise is under -76dBc/Hz@1kHz at 1GHz.

articleTitle: Design of TEC temperature control circuit based on INA330
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the basic principles of TEC (thermoelectric cooler) temperature stability control, which can control the object stay on the same temperature with INA330, PI temperature compensation circuit and power amplifier. The TEC(thermoelectric cooler) control circuit is used to keep the environment temperature of the photodiode stable, which always needs a stable environment temperature to reduce the mistake caused by the dark current and increase the reliability of measurement. We use a G-5852 photodiode which has small dark current under −10°C, produced by HAMAMTSU. In this paper, we tested the circuit and proved that the INA330 TEC control circuit has a good stability and reliability.

articleTitle: Projectile impact point positioning model by acoustic based on dual right square pyramid array
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The conventional positioning on artillery placement by means of seismic wave has poor accuracy. In this paper, a dual right square pyramid lattice model of passive acoustic positioning is proposed to resolve this problem. By means of Time Delay of Arrival (TDOA), a dual right square pyramid positioning geometric model is built. We studied under the constraint conditions by assuming that when dual right square pyramid arm length has length a, the base array spacing is 2b, the height of right square pyramid is c, and right square pyramid formation bottom height from ground is d. In this way, we further investigate the effects of these constraint conditions on positioning accuracy. Simulation results show that when a=1m, b=30m, c=1m, and d=1m, this dual right square pyramid model is better to the test. And the positioning error can be controlled within ± 0.35m in the testing area of 100m × 100m.

articleTitle: A visual program modeling technology based on procedure blueprint
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Software development based on Model Driven Architecture has become the hot pot of software engineering research, however the visualization software development tools of MDA is few. Although some popular development tools such as Rational Rose, ArgoUML, Eclipse provide support for visualized modeling of UML diagrams, UML static diagram is inadequate in behavior process modeling and the mapping of the visualized modeling tools based on UML from model to target code is imperfect. In order to solve this problem, this paper puts forward a visualization program model based on Procedure Blueprint, designs corresponding development tool, gives the prototype experiment system, and implements the automatic generation from model to code to represent the visualized program model.

articleTitle: A fast additively symmetric homomorphic encryption scheme for vector data
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Homomorphic encryption scheme enables direct operations over the encrypted data without decryption. We propose a fast homomorphic encryption scheme for vector data. In the scheme, vector data are transformed to specific bit strings such that addition of two plaintexts could be completed by just a simple XOR operation over the corresponding ciphertexts. Experiments show that the new scheme is about 30% faster than the current fastest homomorphic encryption scheme. In comparison with the prior works, the new scheme is more suitable for dealing with a large number of encrypted data in relational table.

articleTitle: Infrared and visual images fusion based on resolution enhancement
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Under poor lighting conditions, by using the properties of infrared and visual image, based on wavelet transform a fusion algorithm for the infrared and visual image in the same scene is proposed. This fusion algorithm makes image edge in highlight and remains the spatial details. Firstly, wavelet is decomposed. Secondly, a fusion rule of correlation coefficient combining with weighting and selection is used for the low-frequency component which reflects approximate contents. The fusion method for regional average gradient combining with weighting and selection is used for the high-frequency component which reflects detail features of image. Finally, through an inverse transform of wavelet, the fusion image is reconstructed. Experimental results prove that by using this algorithm, the mutual information between the images can be fused organically, the image resolution is raised, the details of fusion image are enhanced, the edge information is reappeared better, and object from infrared image is showed. Strong support for the follow-up target identification, follow-up information analysis and extractive ability of the images is provided.

articleTitle: Architecture design of joint mission space model based on BOM
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: BOM was created to encourage and support reuse, interoperability, composability for distributed simulation system. The BOM standard documentation explains the main conceptual model components: Entity Type, State Machine, Event Type, and Pattern of Interplay. Ontologies are known to promote easy understanding, shared consensus view as well as semantic interoperability. Thus, this paper explores the use of joint mission space entity ontology as a knowledge representation and as a medium for semantic interoperability to BOM, and give the mechanism for modeling joint mission space BOM (JMSBOM) entity.

articleTitle: Neighborhood preserving concept factorization algorithm for data representation
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) and concept factorization (CF) have attracted great attention in pattern recognition and machine learning. However, NMF and CF do not explore the local manifold structure among the high dimensional data. In this paper, a novel semi-supervised matrix factorization method, called Neighborhood Preserving Concept Factorization (NPCF), is proposed. The NPCF algorithm exploits local manifold structure information among the data with resorting to adding neighborhood preserving regulation. This method makes full use for the local geometric structure information in concept factorization. Therefore, the NPCF algorithm has more discriminate ability than traditional concept factorization. Meanwhile, the updating rules and the convergence proof of the NPCF algorithm are provided in this paper. Experiments on benchmark data sets demonstrate this proposed approach is more effective than other algorithms.

articleTitle: Return probability of random walks on the T-fractal
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Return probability of random walks provides useful information on forecasting the recurrence of extr-eme events. Fractal network is a good approximation of the real network system. In this paper, unbiased discrete random walk on the infinite T-fractal was studied and the focus is return probability. The generating functions of first-return probability for node with degree 1 and 3 were constructed respectively based on the adjacency informa-tion for nodes of T-fractal. Using generating function as a tool, explicit expressions for return probability in finite steps and the global mean first-return time were derived. Results show that return probability is less than 1 and the global mean first-return time is 47/6.

articleTitle: 3D face recognition method based on medium frequency information of geometry image
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Facial expression is a main problem in the field of 3D face recognition. To overcome the deficiency,this paper proposed a novel face recognition method based on Detailed Geometry Image (DGI). The DGI, which stays invariant under face expressions, is obtained from multi-scale wavelet transform of three different face regions: the circular area around the nose, the upper face region and the entire face region. Then, an authentication score is gained by combining values of their DGIs. Extensive experiments carried out on the available database FRGC(Face Recognition Grand Challenge) v2.0 achieve a 95.7% verification rate with 0.1% False Acceptance Rate (FAR). Experimental results approve that our method is promising in dealing with expression distortion in 3D face recognition.

articleTitle: Foreground editing technique to reduce interaction
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper we introduce a method to extract foreground from an image or a video and blend it into another environment. We analyze the weakness of previous algorithms, and propose a new method to improve the automaticity of the algorithm and reduce interactions with users. Self-adaption threshold and segmentation technique are used to preprocess the images or frames. And then we use the image matting and illustration technique to refine the segmentation results. Our method is also suitable for video editing to reduce the users operation. The experiment demonstrates that our algorithm can be used under several challenging scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on dual-platform-based wireless App Developement and system implementation
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, our main research is on Mobile application development technologies in the cross-platform which is supported by most popular development tools and frameworks PhoneGap. This technology can develop programs in different phone platforms by using HTML+JavaScript+CSS structure. By applying the above technology we have developed a Dual-platform video App and a background video information distribution system, which can use on both Android and iOS operating system.

articleTitle: A dynamic frame of signal sorting based on data stream clustering
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to solve the contradiction between the accuracy and the real-time in signal sorting, a dynamic signal sorting frame based on data stream clustering was proposed. The frame can be divided into two parts: on-line part and off-line part. In on-line part, the reconnaissance data was transformed and saved as grid frame; in off-line part, the grid frame was sorted with the algorithm of grid-based clustering. Experimental results show that the proposed frame can sort the high density and complex reconnaissance data stream without any prior knowledge, and is not sensitive to the influence of noise. The requirement of accuracy and real-time in signal sorting can be satisfied with this frame.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic performance controlling using intelligent algorithm for hydroelectric generator
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The control method applied to our hydraulic generator product is still the traditional PID control. This method can't realize self-tuning of control parameters online. To enhance the adaptability of the system, the intelligent control technology is applied to the hydraulic turbine generator set which has effectively improved the dynamic operation performance in different cases. Through theoretical derivation and simulation analysis, we summarized the control performance of improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) method is superior to the fuzzy PID control, when both of them are applied to the hydroelectric regulating system and excitation control system.

articleTitle: Novel no-search fractal image compression method on texture feature
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A novel no-search fractal compression method is proposed by generating the contracted domain block from domain block with the texture feature of the corresponding range block to improve the quality of reconstruction image. The greylevel of the pixels in contracted domain blocks were increased or decreased from the mean of neighboring four pixels in corresponding domain blocks according to the difference between the value of the corresponding pixels in the range block and the average of this range block. Compared with traditional spatial contraction method, the proposed method increases the number of the 2×2 range blocks whose scale parameters are in the valid range, and that reduces the collage error obviously. Experiments on standard images show that the proposed scheme with new spatial contraction method improves the quality of the reconstructed images with nearly the same time consumption.

articleTitle: Study on the design and implementation of the computer distance education system
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to solve the sharing problem of the distance education distributed resource online technically, we described the methods and advantages of building the distance education system based on CORBA/Java, achieve resource sharing and information exchange among the heterogeneous systems. According to this model, we established a C/A/S model framework of the distributed distance education system based on CORBA, and designed and developed the realization of the internal teaching platform in detail. In this paper, we try to solve “how to share the distributed resource among the heterogeneous systems” and “how to achieve high efficient interaction based on the status of network devices in the current” two major problems of the computer distance education development through the application of the CORBA technology in distance education system.

articleTitle: The basic method for using QPN to model routing protocol under RWP mobility in DTNs
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: By routing protocol modeling, we can better understand the performance characteristics in different causes. In this paper, we will use the excellent tool in distributed systems and parallel systems, named QPN (Queueing Petri Net). And, we use the simulation tools of QPN, including QPME2.01 and SimQPN, to model the important metrics of routing method in Delay Tolerant Networks. In our previous paper, we have proposed a new routing protocol in DTNs, called “OOPFE-Routing”. In this paper, not only we use ns2 to record the simulation results and to calculate the important mobile parameters such as IMT and CT, but also we put these parameters into QPN tool to model the routing protocol for the DTNs. We will propose these basic methods. After we have model the routing, we can use QPN tools to do stability analysis and continues to analysis other experimental results credibility.

articleTitle: Hybrid position-attitude control of DF-UAV based on generalized flight dynamics
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: For a ducted fan unmanned aerial vehicle (DF-UAV), the aerodynamic forces comprising the aerodynamic lift and drag as well as their induced angular moments are the real physical inputs dominating the flight state. These forces originate from the motions of the duct, propeller and control surfaces. Therefore, this study considered an integrated modeling of DF-UAV and proposed a layered design method for the hybrid position-attitude controller based on the reference feedback and dynamic decoupling.

articleTitle: Stripe action: A novel technique for performing icons in multi-touch interfaces
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper we present a novel technique called Stripe Action for performing icons in multi-touch interfaces. The technique has two operational modes: local and global modes which are used for dealing with single or multiple icons. We focus on addressing three fundamental operations: selection, zooming and rotation. Stripe Action can set up links among icons and endow the same attribute to each icon in the same group. We also design the Strip Menu that is employed to select operational manners. A user study is designed and conducted. The experimental results show that our proposed technique is efficient and provides easy and intuitive operational manners for users to perform icons.

articleTitle: Network situation prediction based on optimized SVR model
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Accurate assessment of network situation has important function in improving the performance and QoS of the network. Since support vector regression emerges as a novel machine study method, it is good at searching implied regression functions according to limit observing data. SVR functions can be used to predict future data. Although PSO-based algorithms are easy, they tend to drop into local extremum. Therefore, chaos particle swarm optimization is used in this paper to optimize the vector parameter, based on which the network situation predicting model is established. The experiments adopt the dataset in Honeynet and actual network traffic to verify the effect of improved algorithm. The results show that chaos PSO scheme has overcome the subjectivity in SVM parameters selection effectively. It praised the prediction accuracy of network situation and has better comprehensive performance compared to traditional prediction methods.

articleTitle: Frequency planning framework for multi-hop OFDMA-based cellular networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, we consider frequency planning of orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA) based cellular networks, with two-hop decode-and-forward relay stations (RSs). We develop a new framework for the mathematical modeling of the frequency planning problem, which aims at suppressing multi-links interference and enhancing spectral efficiency. The concept of incidence coloring from modern graph theory is utilized to recast the original frequency planning problem and guide the solution from graph theory perspective.

articleTitle: Remotely sensed estimate of biomass carbon stocks in Xilingol grassland using MODIS NDVI data
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Accurate estimate of grassland biomass carbon stock is very important to carbon cycling and rational utilization of grassland resources. The natural ecosystem of Xilingol grassland has traditionally been the source of the most productive and highest quality grass in northern China. Based on the plant growing season MODIS-NDVI and Meteorological data, the present study employed the CASA model and plants withered loss model to estimate the above-ground carbon stocks of Xilingol grassland in 2002, 2005, 2009, and further calculate the below-ground biomass carbon stock according to the proportion of above-ground and under-ground biomass. The validation result indicates that the model achieved the reasonable results with an accuracy of 92.47%. Generally, the biomass carbon stocks in Xilingol grassland experienced a decreasing trend from 2002 to 2009., with a total carbon stock of 8.68, 8.09 and 7.61Tg (1Tg=1×1012g) in 2002, 2005, and 2009, respectively, and the corresponding below-ground biomass carbon stock was 40.64, 37.48 and 36.04Tg in three study years, which is approximately five times about the above-ground.

articleTitle: A research on the medical image authentication watermark method based on chaos
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Aiming at safety problems in the storage and transmission process of medical images, this paper puts forward a completely fragile watermark algorithm based on chaos for the authentication of the integrity of medical images and tamper localization. The algorithm utilizes original medical image blocks and calculates gray average image sub-blocks as image characteristic watermarks. In addition, it uses chaos technology to encrypt watermarks, determines the position of each embedded watermark bit and embeds the watermark in the least significant bit of each pixel of medical images. The experimental results show that the method not only is appropriate for the authentication of medical images but also has high and stable Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR), strong sensibility to tamper as well as high tamper positional accuracy and safety.

articleTitle: In-flight coarse alignment for aerostat strapdown inertial navigation system aided by single GPS antenna
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To meet the need of attitude initialization for an in-flight aerostat strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS), three coarse alignment methods aided by single GPS antenna were investigated: Specific Force Integrating Method (SFIM), Quaternion Based Analytical Method (QBAM), and Freeze Inertial Body Frame method (FIBFM). Theories of the methods were illustrated and the aerostat motion characteristics in stratospheric was analyzed. Then simulations were carried out to evaluate the performance of the methods. Comparison results showed that, the SFIM and the QBAM would not perform as expected in the presence of aerostat heading rotation, while the FIBFM could afford the disadvantage from the angular motion and obtain an acceptable coarse alignment result, which was proved by 50 times Monte-Carlo simulations.

articleTitle: Research on the precise algorithm on the inversion of soil permittivity based on GNSS-R signal
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper puts forward a precise algorithm aiming at improving the existing approximate algorithm for the inversion of soil permittivity based on the reflected GNSS signal. By researching the relationship between the soil permittivity and the distinct polarization component received from the reflected GNSS signal, we find a rule of correspondence between the two, which is a precise relationship without any mathematic approximation. When applied to the inversion of soil permittivity, the simulation results show that the new algorithm can improve the inversion accuracy and reduce the errors greatly.

articleTitle: The research on Outlook password recovery
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Outlook is the email client in the Microsoft office package, which has become one of the most widely applied email processing systems in the personal and commercial office environment. This paper studies the password recovery for various accounts in Outlook and we find the method of online recovery by exploiting the Windows cryptographic interface DPAPI for sensitive data. This recovery method enables one to retrieve his password very conveniently. Furthermore, we investigate the inner workings of encryption and decryption functions in DPAPI and present a detailed analysis on the encrypted data type, storage structure, cryptographic algorithm and key generation. To the best of our knowledge, for the first time we give the way of offline password recovery which could be remarkably helpful in the computer forensics.

articleTitle: Algorithm of multi-epoch trajectory determination
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: GPS is the most used navigation system in today's transportation world. However the performance of GPS decreases in mountains, valleys, urban canyons, where it is not always possible to track enough satellites to calculate the 3-D position. This paper outlines a new method to improve the performance of GPS positioning service, especially for fixed-route transport (train or bus). The algorithm of multi-epoch trajectory determination (METD) is based on multi-epoch observations with Least Squares Adjustment (LSA) to track the trajectory of the moving object. The result is satisfactory, even when the current visible satellites are insufficient.

articleTitle: Adaptive filtering based real-time position estimation with single-frequency navigation signals
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A new real-time position estimation procedure using measurements from single-frequency navigation signals is presented in this paper. The new procedure possesses two features. One is that the wavelet reconstruction is taken advantage in the preprocessing to detect and correct cycle slips under strong noises of single-frequency combination signals. Another is that conventional adaptive Kalman filtering algorithm is improved by adjusting the state covariance matrix based on the previous estimators' update, and adjusting the measurement covariance matrix based on measurement innovations. Applications on both practical data and kinetic simulation prove the effectiveness of our new algorithms.

articleTitle: A new kind of HDR image tone compression algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings 2013 International Conference on Mechatronic Sciences, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to display and output HDR(High Dynamic Range) images on the conventional equipments, this thesis proposed a new kind of HDR image tone compression algorithm based on local environmental luminance factor. The workflow of new algorithm is based on the latest image color appearance model iCAM06, as shown in Fig.1. The new algorithm decomposed the original HDR image into the base layer image and detail layer image by the edge-preserving filter method. Then the tone compression function based on the environmental luminance factor was used for the tone range compression of HDR image. And this is the innovation point of the thesis. Lastly the thesis used the image quality evaluation model based on the dynamic range independence to evaluate the reproduction accuracy performance of new HDR tone compression algorithm. The distortion probability graph derived from the original HDR image and compressed image shows that the tone range compression performance of the new algorithm is better than the other algorithm. In addition, the new tone compression function has a low complexity and high execution efficiency.
